prompt: Automation and artificial intelligence are rapidly transforming the job market. Some fear that these technologies will lead to widespread unemployment, while others argue that they will create new job opportunities and improve productivity. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
essay:
One of the most pressing issues in recent years is whether automation and artificial intelligence (AI) will take over human workforces. While some people are concerned that  AI and the advanced technologies make a large number of employees redundant, others argue that new technologies can bring a positive impact in terms of saving time and an increase in productivity. I hold that the developed technologies can improve productivity and time management, but we cannot ignore the problems of AI and automation.

Indeed, it is undeniable that technologies provide a range of benefits to society and individuals. First of all, AI allows people to reduce the time to organise simple and repetitive tasks, which can help people to devote more time to complicated works required human judgement. For example, in Korea, many car factories have introduced AI robots to carry heavy parts of cars and assemble them.  Beyond that, such technologies enable the replacement of dangerous work positions that people are reluctant to work in, such as high-rise building window cleaners and manufacturing sectors. As a result, technology can be beneficial for individuals and workplaces.

Although I acknowledge the aforementioned argument, I believe that reliance on technologies can lead to a loss of human ability related to critical thinking and problem-solving. This is mainly because many individuals tend to rely on AI to generate  tasks that people need to do themselves, which can lead to detrimental impacts, such as skill deterioration. A good example of this is that students who are likely to use AI to generate their essays regularly might lose their ability to address essay questions by themselves and undermine organising thinking and writing skills.

Overall, while it is inevitable that modern technologies have several positive influences on companies and workers in terms of accessibility and productivity, I am of the opinion that overreliance on AI and automation can result in a loss of human ability to process their work and redundancy.
